description: This Java source file defines the PrimaryKeyFinder class, which extends Finder, and provides functionality to locate entity records by primary key within the Apache OFBiz framework. It utilizes various utility classes and models to construct and execute entity queries based on context and configuration.

classes.name: PrimaryKeyFinder
classes.description: A class that provides the ability to find an entity's value using its primary key by leveraging the delegator and model definitions within OFBiz. It can locate entities based on context parameters and supports cache control and dynamic field selection.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyFinder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the finder with XML element configuration, extracting attributes such as value fields, auto field map, and select fields.

methods.name: runFind
methods.description: Executes the find operation to retrieve the entity's primary key value, constructs the key from context, and performs the database lookup with options for caching and partial selection.
